description:
Is this the ultimate small form factor console killer? In this video, I put together one of the craziest Mini PC setups I've ever tested! We are pairing a barebones Minisforum Mini PC (powered by an AMD Ryzen 7 255) with the ONEXGPU 2 (packing a Radeon RX 7800M with 12GB VRAM) via a lightning-fast OCuLink connection.

This Is The Mini PC i Used: https://amzn.to/4qnIc2O

Instead of sticking to Windows, we loaded up the official SteamOS to see if this dual-unit powerhouse can deliver a flawless, console-like 4K gaming experience. From ironing out early eGPU Linux issues to explaining why AMD's architecture beats Intel for this specific OS, we cover it all. Plus, we push this rig to the limit with massive titles like Forza Horizon 6, Cyberpunk 2077, and Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart!
